mainInvokeProfile.name: invoke-json-undefined-v1
mainInvokeProfile.note: The private host controller invokes a bounded MoonBit-owned kernel with captured document authority. No public renderer path. Bounded tagged JSON/undefined values for invoke only; not full clone/error compatibility. Invalid handleOnce callbacks reject immediately. Native integration must reconcile invalidated tickets; the differential candidate uses a synthetic trusted-host driver, not a renderer.

rows.scope: CJS resolution and immutable source inventory
rows.gap: Runtime-owned facade declares the app surface; not an Electron compatibility proof or a real packaged app run. Real CJS main and dependency share the facade in a macOS fixture; broad dependency graphs and arbitrary apps are not yet accepted.

MoonBit lifecycle drives the facade and a real socketpair probe. The unchanged full fixture passes listener registration and reaches readiness, then reports failed/ready-rejected with exitCode 1. No native host or BrowserWindow API in this branch. Native AppKit close gestures and app.quit before-quit/close/will-quit cancellation are mediated by native ACKs and MoonBit state. Queued stale notifications are ignored in deterministic tests. Host-loss fault injection prevents false normal-quit events; real macOS CJS tests validate quit event arguments. Experimental outer-frame size/position array getter and setter aliases reuse native bounds ACKs and preserve unmodified axes. Renderer beforeunload/unload, human physical UI, multi-display geometry and complete Electron event ordering remain unverified.

Probe verdict NO_PUBLIC_SYNC_PROXY: public cross-world primitives do not establish a secure synchronous function proxy. Synchronous bridge remains unresolved. The full fixture fails during window creation before preload or contextBridge execute. Separately pinned sandboxed Electron 44.7.0 preload baseline now validates first-script sync/Promise/frozen-data and documents callback identity vs disposer behavior; this is oracle evidence only. Test-only isolated WKContentWorld M0 diagnostic measures synchronous DOM-event dispatch, page-forgeable reply data, page-induced isolated native echo with no initiator attestation, test-only native document-grant issue/rotation/replay denial, direct child-frame native rejection with isolated Promise confirmation (not original page-initiator authentication), native WKScriptMessageHandlerWithReply Promise and document reload; it does not load an actual Electron preload or implement secure contextBridge, Promise/callback proxies, frozen cross-realm copies or native sender attestation. M0 remains open. The contextBridge handle/registry/bootstrap prerequisite stack is integrated: bounded native-backed JS handles, document-start isolated bootstrap, one-shot native attestation, failed-preload denial and same-URL reload/window-destroy revocation are tested. The public contextBridge API and any synchronous cross-world proxy remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Bounded main listeners, invoke-handler registration and private invocation kernel are implemented. Handler comparison uses real Electron renderer IPC versus a synthetic trusted-host candidate driver, not native candidate E2E. Production renderer ingress, native sender attestation, ipcRenderer and event replies remain unimplemented. Bounded tree codec and request ledger, not ipcRenderer/ipcMain implementations.

No native sender-attestation adapter; caller-supplied metadata is not authentication. Registration grants no renderer authority. Core invocation tickets bind completion to the originally authorized document; native invalidation/reconcile wiring is still required. Private native events revoke MoonBit document grants and malformed native identity frames fail closed; a separate test-only WebKit private selector now triggers genuine content-process termination and public delegate delivery on macOS. Unassisted renderer crashes, native sender attestation and complete renderer/frame origin policy remain open. Native document-start bootstrap and one-shot preload attestation are connected, but arbitrary page-initiated authority and native frame/document attestation for renderer requests remain unproven.

Executed: resize/DPI observation, DOM-synthesized vs trusted posted-event input, native pasteboard, in-process AX role. NOT_RUN: focus/blur (no key status in session), OS paste, IME composition, VoiceOver traversal, hardware keys, second-display DPI. DOM clipboard probe stalled on the web process. Interactive acceptance still required. Requires interactive native WebView acceptance.

Child probe only; full host/Node/WebView process ledger remains open. Native spawn/host loss, worker/FD cleanup and test-triggered real WebKit content-process termination via a private selector were exercised. Unassisted process crashes, external OS SIGKILL, GPU/multiprocess tree accounting, and long-run recovery acceptance remain unverified.
No release bundle, fixed Node payload, signing or comparable measurements.
No real application selected or executed.

caveats: no renderer IPC or privileged preload
native AppKit close requests are cancellable in a performClose CI simulation; physical UI and full Electron ordering are not verified
loadFile is worker-backed and tested against a slow WebKit page; full Electron event ordering remains unverified
no gpui.mbt integration or native sender attestation
concurrent loadFile is fail-closed with ELECTRON_MBT_NAVIGATION_IN_PROGRESS
test-only native WebKit private selector drives a real content-process termination in CI; spontaneous crash and process-tree kill acceptance remain open
one serialized native load worker, with a per-request monotonic deadline from enqueue
worker and native host process cleanup tested for injected faults, not full process-tree verification
native close cancel ACK carries monotonic event identity, stale queued close notifications are ignored
native NSWindow-backed visibility is implemented; Electron show/hide events, focus and Page Visibility API parity are unverified
webContents.getURL synchronously reads the WKWebView URL with strict native ACK validation, but full Electron navigation semantics are unverified
webContents.getTitle reads the actual WKWebView document title independently of NSWindow.title; full Electron document-title event semantics are unverified
BrowserWindow.getBounds reads actual NSWindow.frame as bounded integer coordinates relative to the primary screen top-left; multi-display and geometry-change event parity are unverified

BrowserWindow.setBounds changes the real NSWindow frame with conservative partial integer inputs; animated changes, arbitrary manual move/resize events, tray clamping and multi-display Electron parity are unverified

app.quit respects native-backed close, before-quit and will-quit cancellation, supplies (event, exitCode=0), and suppresses normal quit after host loss; renderer beforeunload/unload is not implemented
isolated bootstrap/attestation prerequisites are integrated; public contextBridge is still NOT_IMPLEMENTED
experimentalSignals: native-close-request (private OS-to-Node signal; distinct from the standard window close event)
